rationale: A single fixed-size vector board reduces cross-format layout drift. Every downstream format is a view/export, never a new source of truth.
pipeline: automatic re-export from canonical SVG on failure
ship only after all required formats PASS

format_policy.PDF: exact A3 media box; preserve vector source where possible
format_policy.PPTX: exact A3 slide EMU; board placed to full slide
format_policy.XLSX: A3 paper size + explicit print area + one-page fit

quality_rule: Page-size PASS is necessary but not sufficient. Source fidelity and architectural presentation evaluation must also PASS.
